<!DOCTYPE html>
<html lang="en">
<head>
<meta charset="UTF-8"/>
<meta name="viewport" content="width=device-width, initial-scale=1.0"/>
<title>Decouple — Pre-signup interview · O4 employment complexity (Expressive)</title>
<link href="https://cdnjs.cloudflare.com/ajax/libs/tailwindcss/2.2.19/tailwind.min.css" rel="stylesheet">
<link rel="preconnect" href="https://fonts.googleapis.com"/>
<link rel="preconnect" href="https://fonts.gstatic.com" crossorigin/>
<link href="https://fonts.googleapis.com/css2?family=Inter:wght@400;500;600;700&family=Source+Serif+Pro:ital,wght@0,400;0,600;0,700;1,400;1,600&family=JetBrains+Mono:wght@400;500&display=swap" rel="stylesheet">
<script src="https://unpkg.com/[email protected]/umd/react.development.js" integrity="sha384-hD6/rw4ppMLGNu3tX5cjIb+uRZ7UkRJ6BPkLpg4hAu/6onKUg4lLsHAs9EBPT82L" crossorigin="anonymous"></script>
<script src="https://unpkg.com/[email protected]/umd/react-dom.development.js" integrity="sha384-u6aeetuaXnQ38mYT8rp6sbXaQe3NL9t+IBXmnYxwkUI2Hw4bsp2Wvmx4yRQF1uAm" crossorigin="anonymous"></script>
<script src="https://unpkg.com/@babel/[email protected]/babel.min.js" integrity="sha384-m08KidiNqLdpJqLq95G/LEi8Qvjl/xUYll3QILypMoQ65QorJ9Lvtp2RXYGBFj1y" crossorigin="anonymous"></script>
<style>
  html, body { margin: 0; padding: 0; }
  body {
    font-family: 'Inter', -apple-system, BlinkMacSystemFont, sans-serif;
    background: #F2EFF6;
    color: #1A1A1A;
    -webkit-font-smoothing: antialiased;
    font-feature-settings: "ss01","cv11";
  }
  .serif { font-family: 'Source Serif Pro', Georgia, serif; }
  .mono  { font-family: 'JetBrains Mono', ui-monospace, Menlo, monospace; }
  .label-xs { font-size: 10.5px; letter-spacing: 0.14em; text-transform: uppercase; font-weight: 600; }
  .tabular { font-variant-numeric: tabular-nums; }
  *:focus-visible { outline: 2px solid #1A1A1A; outline-offset: 2px; border-radius: 4px; }
  .plate { background: #F5F5F4; border: 1px solid #E5E3DC; border-radius: 14px; }
  .vrow {
    display: grid;
    grid-template-columns: 220px 1fr;
    gap: 28px;
    align-items: start;
  }
</style>
</head>
<body>
<template id="__bundler_thumbnail">
  <svg xmlns="http://www.w3.org/2000/svg" viewBox="0 0 400 400">
    <defs>
      <linearGradient id="thumbBg" x1="0" y1="0" x2="0" y2="1">
        <stop offset="0%" stop-color="#EEEAF4"/>
        <stop offset="100%" stop-color="#F8F5EF"/>
      </linearGradient>
    </defs>
    <rect width="400" height="400" fill="url(#thumbBg)"/>
    <g transform="translate(110 110)">
      <rect x="0" y="0"   width="180" height="22" rx="6" fill="#FFFFFF" stroke="#E5E3DC"/>
      <rect x="0" y="32"  width="180" height="22" rx="6" fill="#1A1A1A"/>
      <rect x="0" y="64"  width="180" height="22" rx="6" fill="#FFFFFF" stroke="#E5E3DC"/>
      <rect x="0" y="96"  width="180" height="22" rx="6" fill="#FFFFFF" stroke="#E5E3DC"/>
      <rect x="0" y="148" width="180" height="14" rx="7" fill="#1A1A1A"/>
    </g>
  </svg>
</template>
<div id="root"></div>

<script type="text/babel" src="o4-frames.jsx"></script>
<script type="text/babel" data-presets="react">
const { useState } = React;
const { INK, SUB, MUTE, LINE, VIOLET, INDIGO, MAGENTA, EXPRESSIVE_BG, OPTIONS_FULL, TITLES, HELPER } = window.o4;

/* ====== INTERACTIVE RESOLVED FRAME — A1 + B2 + C3 ====== */

function Arrow({ size = 13, sw = 1.8, dir = "right" }) {
  const r = { right: 0, left: 180, down: 90, up: 270 }[dir] || 0;
  return (
    <svg width={size} height={size} viewBox="0 0 24 24" fill="none" stroke="currentColor" strokeWidth={sw} strokeLinecap="round" strokeLinejoin="round" style={{ transform: `rotate(${r}deg)` }}>
      <line x1="5" y1="12" x2="19" y2="12" />
      <polyline points="12 5 19 12 12 19" />
    </svg>
  );
}

function StepRail({ current = 4, total = 8 }) {
  return (
    <div className="flex items-center gap-2.5">
      <span className="label-xs" style={{ color: MUTE, fontSize: 9.5 }}>Step {current} / {total}</span>
      <div className="relative rounded-full overflow-hidden" style={{ width: 96, height: 3, background: "#E5E3DC" }}>
        <div className="absolute rounded-full" style={{ top: 0, bottom: 0, left: 0, width: `${(current / total) * 100}%`, background: INK }} />
      </div>
    </div>
  );
}

function LiveOptionRow({ opt, selected, emphasized, onSelect }) {
  const padV = emphasized ? 18 : 14;
  const fontS = emphasized ? 15 : 14;
  return (
    <button type="button" aria-pressed={selected} onClick={onSelect} style={{
      display: "flex", alignItems: "center", gap: 12,
      width: "100%",
      background: selected ? INK : "#FFFFFF",
      border: `1px solid ${selected ? INK : LINE}`,
      borderRadius: 14,
      padding: `${padV}px 14px`,
      textAlign: "left",
      cursor: "pointer",
      transition: "background 120ms ease-out, border-color 120ms ease-out, padding 160ms ease-out",
      boxShadow: emphasized && !selected ? "0 1px 0 rgba(26,26,26,0.04), 0 6px 14px rgba(26,26,26,0.05)" : "none"
    }}>
      <span style={{
        flex: "none",
        width: 18, height: 18, borderRadius: 999,
        border: `1.5px solid ${selected ? "#FFFFFF" : "#C9C5BD"}`,
        background: selected ? INK : "#FFFFFF",
        display: "inline-flex", alignItems: "center", justifyContent: "center"
      }}>
        {selected && (<span style={{ width: 8, height: 8, borderRadius: 999, background: "#FFFFFF" }} />)}
      </span>
      <span style={{ flex: 1, lineHeight: 1.25 }}>
        <span style={{ display: "block", fontSize: fontS, fontWeight: 600, color: selected ? "#FFFFFF" : INK }}>
          {opt.primary}
          {opt.detail && (
            <span className="serif italic" style={{ fontWeight: 400, color: selected ? "rgba(255,255,255,0.7)" : SUB, marginLeft: 6 }}>
              — {opt.detail}
            </span>
          )}
        </span>
      </span>
    </button>
  );
}

function ResolvedFrame({ answer, setAnswer }) {
  const enabled = answer !== null;
  return (
    <div style={{
      width: 375,
      height: 760,
      borderRadius: 36,
      padding: 8,
      background: "#1A1A1A",
      boxShadow: "0 24px 60px rgba(79,70,229,0.16), 0 6px 16px rgba(26,26,26,0.06)"
    }}>
      <div style={{
        width: "100%", height: "100%",
        background: EXPRESSIVE_BG,
        borderRadius: 28, overflow: "hidden",
        position: "relative",
        display: "flex", flexDirection: "column"
      }}>
        <div className="flex items-center justify-between px-6 pt-3 pb-1"
             style={{ fontSize: 11, color: INK, fontWeight: 600 }}>
          <span>9:41</span>
          <span style={{ letterSpacing: 1, fontSize: 9, color: MUTE }}>RESOLVED · A1 · B2 · C3</span>
          <span className="mono" style={{ fontSize: 10, color: MUTE }}>●●●</span>
        </div>

        {/* TopBar */}
        <div className="px-5 pt-2 pb-3 flex items-center justify-between"
             style={{ borderBottom: `1px solid ${LINE}` }}>
          <a href="#" className="inline-flex items-center gap-1.5 text-[11px]" style={{ color: SUB }}>
            <Arrow dir="left" size={11} />
            <span>Back</span>
          </a>
          <StepRail current={4} total={8} />
          <div style={{ width: 36 }} aria-hidden="true" />
        </div>

        {/* Hero — A1 caption below */}
        <div className="px-5 pt-4 pb-3">
          <div className="label-xs flex items-center gap-1.5" style={{ color: INDIGO, fontSize: 9.5 }}>
            <span style={{ width: 5, height: 5, borderRadius: 999, background: INDIGO }} />
            <span>Money</span>
          </div>
          <h2 className="serif mt-2" style={{ fontSize: 21, lineHeight: 1.18, letterSpacing: "-0.015em", fontWeight: 600 }}>
            {TITLES.B2}
          </h2>
          <p className="mt-2 text-[12px]" style={{ color: SUB, lineHeight: 1.45 }}>
            {HELPER}
          </p>
        </div>

        {/* Body — C3 emphasis on "No" */}
        <div className="px-5 pt-1 pb-3 flex-1 overflow-hidden flex flex-col">
          <div className="space-y-2">
            {OPTIONS_FULL.map((opt) => (
              <LiveOptionRow
                key={opt.key} opt={opt}
                selected={answer === opt.key}
                emphasized={opt.key === "no"}
                onSelect={() => setAnswer(opt.key)}
              />
            ))}
          </div>
        </div>

        {/* Footer */}
        <div className="px-5 pt-3 pb-4 mt-auto" style={{
          borderTop: `1px solid ${LINE}`,
          background: "rgba(255,255,255,0.6)",
          backdropFilter: "blur(10px)"
        }}>
          <div className="text-center text-[10.5px] mb-2.5 px-2" style={{ color: SUB, lineHeight: 1.35, minHeight: 14 }}>
            {!enabled && <span style={{ color: MUTE }}>Pick the option that fits to continue.</span>}
            {enabled && <span className="serif italic">Answer recorded — continue when ready.</span>}
          </div>
          <button disabled={!enabled} style={{
            width: "100%",
            background: enabled ? INK : "#E5E3DC",
            color: enabled ? "#FFFFFF" : "#A8A29E",
            padding: "13px 18px",
            borderRadius: 999,
            fontSize: 14, fontWeight: 600,
            border: "none",
            display: "inline-flex", alignItems: "center", justifyContent: "center", gap: 8,
            cursor: enabled ? "pointer" : "not-allowed"
          }}>
            <span>Continue</span>
            <Arrow dir="right" size={13} sw={2} />
          </button>
        </div>
      </div>
    </div>
  );
}

function AnnotPill({ children, color }) {
  return (
    <span className="mono inline-block px-2 py-1 rounded"
          style={{ background: color || "#1A1A1A", color: "#FFFFFF", fontSize: 10.5, letterSpacing: "0.04em" }}>
      {children}
    </span>
  );
}

/* ====== Variant grid section ====== */
function VariantGroup({ id, title, lede, frames, resolvedKey, blurbs }) {
  return (
    <section className="plate p-8 mt-8" data-screen-label={`04 ${id} variants`}>
      <div className="vrow">
        <div>
          <div className="label-xs" style={{ color: MAGENTA }}>Decision {id}</div>
          <h3 className="serif mt-2" style={{ fontSize: 22, lineHeight: 1.15, letterSpacing: "-0.015em", fontWeight: 600 }}>
            {title}
          </h3>
          <p className="mt-3 text-[13px]" style={{ color: SUB, lineHeight: 1.55 }}>
            {lede}
          </p>
          <div className="mt-4 mono text-[11px]" style={{ color: MUTE, letterSpacing: "0.04em", lineHeight: 1.7 }}>
            <span>resolved → </span>
            <span style={{ color: INK, fontWeight: 600 }}>{id}{resolvedKey}</span>
          </div>
        </div>

        <div className="grid gap-6" style={{ gridTemplateColumns: "repeat(3, minmax(0, 1fr))" }}>
          {frames.map((f, i) => {
            const key = `${id}${i + 1}`;
            const isResolved = key === `${id}${resolvedKey}`;
            return (
              <div key={i} className="flex flex-col">
                <div className="flex items-baseline justify-between mb-3">
                  <div className="flex items-center gap-2">
                    <AnnotPill color={isResolved ? INK : "#9F9A92"}>{key}</AnnotPill>
                    <span className="text-[12.5px]" style={{ color: INK, fontWeight: 600 }}>{f.title}</span>
                  </div>
                  {isResolved && (
                    <span className="mono text-[9.5px]" style={{ color: INK, letterSpacing: "0.06em" }}>RESOLVED</span>
                  )}
                </div>
                <div style={{
                  borderRadius: 18,
                  padding: 16,
                  background: isResolved ? "#FFFFFF" : "transparent",
                  border: isResolved ? `1px solid ${LINE}` : `1px dashed #D6D3CC`,
                  display: "flex", justifyContent: "center"
                }}>
                  <div style={{ width: 320, height: 649, position: "relative" }}>
                    <div style={{ transform: "scale(0.853)", transformOrigin: "top left", width: 375, height: 760 }}>
                      {f.node}
                    </div>
                  </div>
                </div>
                <p className="mt-3 text-[12px]" style={{ color: SUB, lineHeight: 1.5 }}>
                  {blurbs[i]}
                </p>
              </div>
            );
          })}
        </div>
      </div>
    </section>
  );
}

function App() {
  const [answer, setAnswer] = useState(null);

  return (
    <div className="min-h-screen" style={{ background: "linear-gradient(180deg, #EEEAF4 0%, #F4EFE9 520px, #EFEEE9 100%)" }}>
      <header className="px-12 pt-12 pb-8 max-w-[1480px] mx-auto" data-screen-label="04 Header">
        <div className="flex items-baseline justify-between flex-wrap gap-y-3">
          <div>
            <div className="label-xs" style={{ color: INDIGO }}>
              Decouple · Pre-signup interview · Wireframe O4 · Expressive
            </div>
            <h1 className="serif mt-2" style={{ fontSize: 36, lineHeight: 1.1, letterSpacing: "-0.02em", fontWeight: 600 }}>
              Employment complexity — <span className="italic" style={{ fontWeight: 400, color: MAGENTA }}>screen 4 of 8</span>
            </h1>
          </div>
          <div className="flex items-center gap-3 text-[12px] mono" style={{ color: SUB }}>
            <AnnotPill color={INDIGO}>O4</AnnotPill>
            <span>preSignup.employmentComplexity</span>
            <span style={{ color: "#C9C5BD" }}>·</span>
            <span>{`{selfEmployedFlag}`}</span>
          </div>
        </div>
        <p className="mt-4 max-w-[920px] text-[14px]" style={{ color: SUB, lineHeight: 1.6 }}>
          One question, four options. The flag this screen sets routes income evidence later — PAYE-only
          households take the slim path; anyone running their own thing gets a different upload step. The
          screen itself can't show that complexity, so it has to ask cleanly. Three calls below: how the
          helper text shows up, how plain to make the wording, and what (if anything) is pre-selected.
        </p>
      </header>

      <main className="px-12 pb-24 max-w-[1480px] mx-auto" data-screen-label="04 Resolved">

        {/* RESOLVED + RAIL */}
        <section className="grid gap-12" style={{ gridTemplateColumns: "minmax(0, 391px) 1fr" }} data-screen-label="04 Resolved live">

          <div className="flex flex-col items-center">
            <div className="mb-5 self-stretch flex items-baseline justify-between">
              <div className="label-xs" style={{ color: INK }}>RESOLVED · LIVE</div>
              <button type="button"
                      onClick={() => setAnswer(null)}
                      className="mono text-[10.5px]"
                      style={{ color: MUTE, letterSpacing: "0.06em", textDecoration: "underline", textUnderlineOffset: 3, cursor: "pointer", background: "transparent", border: "none", padding: 0 }}>
                reset
              </button>
            </div>
            <ResolvedFrame answer={answer} setAnswer={setAnswer} />
          </div>

          <div className="space-y-6">
            <div className="plate p-6">
              <div className="label-xs mb-4" style={{ color: INDIGO }}>Live state</div>
              <div className="space-y-3 text-[13px]" style={{ color: SUB, lineHeight: 1.5 }}>
                <div className="flex items-baseline gap-3">
                  <span className="mono text-[11px]" style={{ color: MUTE, width: 130 }}>employmentMix</span>
                  <span className="mono text-[12.5px]" style={{ color: answer ? INK : MUTE }}>
                    {answer ?? "— not answered —"}
                  </span>
                </div>
                <div className="flex items-center gap-3 pt-2 mt-2" style={{ borderTop: `1px solid ${LINE}` }}>
                  <span className="mono text-[11px]" style={{ color: MUTE, width: 130 }}>derived</span>
                  <span className="mono inline-flex items-center gap-1.5 px-2 py-1 rounded"
                        style={{
                          background: (answer && answer !== "no") ? INK : "#FFFFFF",
                          color: (answer && answer !== "no") ? "#FFFFFF" : MUTE,
                          border: `1px solid ${(answer && answer !== "no") ? INK : LINE}`,
                          fontSize: 10, letterSpacing: "0.04em"
                        }}>
                    <span style={{
                      width: 6, height: 6, borderRadius: 999,
                      background: (answer && answer !== "no") ? "#FFFFFF" : "#D6D3CC"
                    }} />
                    selfEmployedFlag = {(answer && answer !== "no") ? "true" : (answer === "no" ? "false" : "—")}
                  </span>
                </div>
                {answer && answer !== "no" && (
                  <p className="text-[12px] pt-1" style={{ color: SUB, lineHeight: 1.5 }}>
                    Routes the income-evidence step on screen 6 to the self-employed/director path:
                    last 2 years of accounts or SA302s, plus a 3-month bank statement. PAYE households
                    get the slim path: latest payslip + P60.
                  </p>
                )}
                {answer === "no" && (
                  <p className="text-[12px] pt-1" style={{ color: SUB, lineHeight: 1.5 }}>
                    Routes income-evidence step on screen 6 to the slim PAYE path: latest payslip
                    plus P60. No accountant required.
                  </p>
                )}
              </div>
            </div>

            <div className="plate p-6">
              <div className="label-xs mb-3" style={{ color: INDIGO }}>Try these</div>
              <div className="grid grid-cols-2 gap-2 text-[12px]">
                {[
                  { label: "No — common path", k: "no"   },
                  { label: "Yes — I am",       k: "me"   },
                  { label: "Yes — my ex is",   k: "ex"   },
                  { label: "Yes — we both",    k: "both" }
                ].map((s) => (
                  <button key={s.k} type="button"
                          onClick={() => setAnswer(s.k)}
                          style={{
                            background: "#FFFFFF",
                            border: `1px solid ${LINE}`,
                            borderRadius: 10,
                            padding: "10px 12px",
                            textAlign: "left",
                            cursor: "pointer",
                            color: INK, fontWeight: 500
                          }}>
                    {s.label}
                  </button>
                ))}
              </div>
            </div>

            <div className="plate p-6 text-[13px]" style={{ color: SUB, lineHeight: 1.6 }}>
              <div className="label-xs mb-4" style={{ color: INDIGO }}>The three calls</div>
              <div className="space-y-4">
                <div>
                  <div className="flex items-baseline gap-3 mb-1">
                    <AnnotPill>A1</AnnotPill>
                    <span className="serif" style={{ fontSize: 14.5, fontWeight: 600, color: INK }}>Caption below the headline</span>
                  </div>
                  <p>One line, one job. The helper sits where eyes already are after reading the title —
                  no extra tap, no progressive trick. A "?" reveal hides the reason; a delayed reveal
                  withholds it until after the user has already committed.</p>
                </div>
                <div>
                  <div className="flex items-baseline gap-3 mb-1">
                    <AnnotPill>B2</AnnotPill>
                    <span className="serif" style={{ fontSize: 14.5, fontWeight: 600, color: INK }}>Plain rewording</span>
                  </div>
                  <p>"Work for yourself, or run a limited company." The verbatim version uses the right
                  legal phrase but isn't how people describe their own work; the split version is more
                  precise but doubles the questions on a screen we want to feel small.</p>
                </div>
                <div>
                  <div className="flex items-baseline gap-3 mb-1">
                    <AnnotPill>C3</AnnotPill>
                    <span className="serif" style={{ fontSize: 14.5, fontWeight: 600, color: INK }}>Empty + ‘No’ emphasized</span>
                  </div>
                  <p>Nothing is pre-selected — we don't want a quiet auto-acceptance. But the most
                  common path sits a touch larger so it reads as the calm option. Users opt in; we
                  don't decide for them.</p>
                </div>
              </div>
            </div>
          </div>
        </section>

        {/* A — HELPER-TEXT TREATMENT */}
        <VariantGroup
          id="A"
          title="How does the helper text appear?"
          lede="Helper text is small, one line. The question is which moment it shows up: alongside the headline, behind a tap, or after the user has shown intent. The brief says one-line helper, not a paragraph — so the variants live entirely in *when*, not *how much*."
          resolvedKey={1}
          frames={[
            { title: "Caption below", node: <window.o4.A1 /> },
            { title: "‘?’ popover",   node: <window.o4.A2 /> },
            { title: "Reveal on select", node: <window.o4.A3 /> }
          ]}
          blurbs={[
            "Eyes are already there after reading the headline. No friction, no surprise — and screen-reader users get it without an extra control.",
            "Cleaner headline, but the reason is hidden behind a tap. Users who don't see the cue make the call without context. Good for legal screens, wrong for this one.",
            "Helper appears once a row is touched. Reads as a reward but in practice withholds the reason while asking for an answer. Feels coy."
          ]}
        />

        {/* B — PLAIN-LANGUAGE REWORDING */}
        <VariantGroup
          id="B"
          title="How precise vs. how plain?"
          lede="‘Self-employed or company director’ is correct UK terminology. It's also five words of HMRC. Variants test how far we can step toward plain English without losing the legal-shape distinction the income evidence step depends on."
          resolvedKey={2}
          frames={[
            { title: "Verbatim",  node: <window.o4.B1 /> },
            { title: "Plain",     node: <window.o4.B2 /> },
            { title: "Two questions", node: <window.o4.B3 /> }
          ]}
          blurbs={[
            "The brief's words exactly. Precise but distancing — invokes a tax mental model right when we're trying to feel like a friend taking notes.",
            "‘Work for yourself, or run a limited company.’ Same two categories, language anyone would use. The helper does the rest.",
            "Splits the legal-shape distinction into two yes/nos. Maximum precision; doubles the screen's question count and breaks the steady one-question-per-screen rhythm of the interview."
          ]}
        />

        {/* C — EMPTY-STATE DEFAULT */}
        <VariantGroup
          id="C"
          title="What's selected when the screen opens?"
          lede="The most common UK answer is ‘No’ — both PAYE or not working. The question is whether to reflect that statistical reality in the empty state. Three positions on a sliding scale of how much the screen pre-decides for the user."
          resolvedKey={3}
          frames={[
            { title: "Blank slate",      node: <window.o4.C1 /> },
            { title: "‘No’ pre-selected", node: <window.o4.C2 /> },
            { title: "‘No’ emphasized",   node: <window.o4.C3 /> }
          ]}
          blurbs={[
            "Equal weight, no nudge. Honest, but every user pays the cost of an extra tap — including the 80% whose answer is ‘No’.",
            "Fastest for the common case but pre-records an answer the user never gave. If they tap Continue without reading, we've decided for them. Wrong for an evidence question.",
            "Card stays unselected; ‘No’ sits a touch larger so the eye lands there first. The common path feels easier without the screen filling it in."
          ]}
        />

        {/* CANON */}
        <section className="plate p-8 mt-12" data-screen-label="04 Canon">
          <div className="label-xs mb-4" style={{ color: INDIGO }}>Canon — inheritance from O1 / O2 / O3</div>
          <div className="grid grid-cols-3 gap-8 text-[13px]" style={{ color: SUB, lineHeight: 1.55 }}>
            <div>
              <div className="serif mb-2" style={{ fontSize: 15, fontWeight: 600, color: INK }}>Resemble</div>
              <p>Same Inter + Source Serif Pro pairing. Same step rail, advanced to 4 / 8. Same paper-white
              cards on tinted gradient. Italic accent on the trailing detail ("— I am") matches the rhythm
              of O3's relationship list.</p>
            </div>
            <div>
              <div className="serif mb-2" style={{ fontSize: 15, fontWeight: 600, color: INK }}>Differ</div>
              <p>Calmer EXPRESSIVE_BG — violet stop pulled back, cream extended. Eyebrow shifts from
              violet (Your ex) to indigo (Money) so each section of the interview has its own quiet
              chapter colour without changing the overall canvas.</p>
            </div>
            <div>
              <div className="serif mb-2" style={{ fontSize: 15, fontWeight: 600, color: INK }}>Constraints honoured</div>
              <p>No PAYE, IR35, Schedule D anywhere on-screen. The "why" is one line. No "this will take
              longer if Yes" — both branches feel like normal next steps. No red, no warning glyphs:
              this isn't a flag screen, it's a routing screen.</p>
            </div>
          </div>
        </section>

      </main>
    </div>
  );
}

ReactDOM.createRoot(document.getElementById("root")).render(<App/>);
</script>
</body>
</html>

<script src="https://unpkg.com/[email protected]/umd/react.development.js" integrity="sha384-hD6/rw4ppMLGNu3tX5cjIb+uRZ7UkRJ6BPkLpg4hAu/6onKUg4lLsHAs9EBPT82L" crossorigin="anonymous"></script>
<script src="https://unpkg.com/[email protected]/umd/react-dom.development.js" integrity="sha384-u6aeetuaXnQ38mYT8rp6sbXaQe3NL9t+IBXmnYxwkUI2Hw4bsp2Wvmx4yRQF1uAm" crossorigin="anonymous"></script>

<style>
  html, body { margin: 0; padding: 0; }
  body {
    font-family: 'Inter', -apple-system, BlinkMacSystemFont, sans-serif;
    background: #F2EFF6;
    color: #1A1A1A;

  }

    align-items: start;

</style>
</head>
<body>
<template id="__bundler_thumbnail">
  <svg xmlns="http://www.w3.org/2000/svg" viewBox="0 0 400 400">
    <defs>
      <linearGradient id="thumbBg" x1="0" y1="0" x2="0" y2="1">
        <stop offset="0%" stop-color="#EEEAF4"/>
        <stop offset="100%" stop-color="#F8F5EF"/>
      </linearGradient>
    </defs>
    <rect width="400" height="400" fill="url(#thumbBg)"/>
    <g transform="translate(110 110)">
      <rect x="0" y="0"   width="180" height="22" rx="6" fill="#FFFFFF" stroke="#E5E3DC"/>
      <rect x="0" y="32"  width="180" height="22" rx="6" fill="#FFFFFF" stroke="#E5E3DC"/>
      <rect x="0" y="64"  width="180" height="22" rx="6" fill="#FFFFFF" stroke="#E5E3DC"/>
      <line x1="0" y1="100" x2="180" y2="100" stroke="#D6D3CC" stroke-dasharray="3 3"/>
      <rect x="0" y="112" width="180" height="22" rx="6" fill="#1A1A1A"/>
      <rect x="0" y="158" width="180" height="14" rx="7" fill="#4F46E5"/>
    </g>
  </svg>
</template>
<div id="root"></div>

<script type="text/babel" src="o5-frames.jsx"></script>
<script type="text/babel" data-presets="react">
const { useState } = React;
const {
  INK, SUB, MUTE, LINE, HAIR, INDIGO, MAGENTA, VIOLET,
  EXPRESSIVE_BG,
  OPT_FULL, OPT_SOME, OPT_LITTLE, OPT_SUSPECT,
  Hero, Footer, TopBar, MobileFrame, FormBody, defaultCaption
} = window.o5;

function Arrow({ size = 13, sw = 1.8, dir = "right" }) {
  const r = { right: 0, left: 180, down: 90, up: 270 }[dir] || 0;
  return (
    <svg width={size} height={size} viewBox="0 0 24 24" fill="none" stroke="currentColor" strokeWidth={sw} strokeLinecap="round" strokeLinejoin="round" style={{ transform: `rotate(${r}deg)` }}>
      <line x1="5" y1="12" x2="19" y2="12" />
      <polyline points="12 5 19 12 12 19" />
    </svg>
  );
}

/* ====== INTERACTIVE RESOLVED FRAME — A3 + B1 + C2 ====== */

function ResolvedFrame({ answer, setAnswer }) {
  const enabled = answer !== null;
  return (
    <MobileFrame label="RESOLVED · A3 · B1 · C2">
      <TopBar />
      <Hero framing="B1" />
      <FormBody
        aTreatment="A3"
        cVariant="C2"
        selectedKey={answer}
        onSelect={(k) => setAnswer(k)}
      />
      <Footer
        enabled={enabled}
        caption={defaultCaption(enabled)}
      />
    </MobileFrame>
  );
}

function AnnotPill({ children, color }) {
  return (
    <span className="mono inline-block px-2 py-1 rounded"
          style={{ background: color || "#1A1A1A", color: "#FFFFFF", fontSize: 10.5, letterSpacing: "0.04em" }}>
      {children}
    </span>
  );
}

/* ====== Variant grid section ====== */
function VariantGroup({ id, title, lede, frames, resolvedKey, blurbs, screenLabel }) {
  return (
    <section className="plate p-8 mt-8" data-screen-label={screenLabel}>
      <div className="vrow">
        <div>
          <div className="label-xs" style={{ color: MAGENTA }}>Decision {id}</div>
          <h3 className="serif mt-2" style={{ fontSize: 22, lineHeight: 1.15, letterSpacing: "-0.015em", fontWeight: 600 }}>
            {title}
          </h3>
          <p className="mt-3 text-[13px]" style={{ color: SUB, lineHeight: 1.55 }}>
            {lede}
          </p>
          <div className="mt-4 mono text-[11px]" style={{ color: MUTE, letterSpacing: "0.04em", lineHeight: 1.7 }}>
            <span>resolved → </span>
            <span style={{ color: INK, fontWeight: 600 }}>{id}{resolvedKey}</span>
          </div>
        </div>

        <div className="grid gap-6" style={{ gridTemplateColumns: "repeat(3, minmax(0, 1fr))" }}>
          {frames.map((f, i) => {
            const key = `${id}${i + 1}`;
            const isResolved = key === `${id}${resolvedKey}`;
            return (
              <div key={i} className="flex flex-col">
                <div className="flex items-baseline justify-between mb-3">
                  <div className="flex items-center gap-2">
                    <AnnotPill color={isResolved ? INK : "#9F9A92"}>{key}</AnnotPill>
                    <span className="text-[12.5px]" style={{ color: INK, fontWeight: 600 }}>{f.title}</span>
                  </div>
                  {isResolved && (
                    <span className="mono text-[9.5px]" style={{ color: INK, letterSpacing: "0.06em" }}>RESOLVED</span>
                  )}
                </div>
                <div style={{
                  borderRadius: 18,
                  padding: 16,
                  background: isResolved ? "#FFFFFF" : "transparent",
                  border: isResolved ? `1px solid ${LINE}` : `1px dashed #D6D3CC`,
                  display: "flex", justifyContent: "center"
                }}>
                  <div style={{ width: 320, height: 649, position: "relative" }}>
                    <div style={{ transform: "scale(0.853)", transformOrigin: "top left", width: 375, height: 760 }}>
                      {f.node}
                    </div>
                  </div>
                </div>
                <p className="mt-3 text-[12px]" style={{ color: SUB, lineHeight: 1.5 }}>
                  {blurbs[i]}
                </p>
              </div>
            );
          })}
        </div>
      </div>
    </section>
  );
}

function App() {
  const [answer, setAnswer] = useState(null);

  /* derived: does the answer route into the hidden-assets pathway? */
  const hiddenAssetsFlag = answer === "suspect";
  const supportLevel = answer === "full"    ? "light"
                     : answer === "some"    ? "standard"
                     : answer === "little"  ? "high"
                     : answer === "suspect" ? "high · forensic add-on"
                     : "—";

  return (
    <div className="min-h-screen" style={{ background: "linear-gradient(180deg, #EEEAF4 0%, #F4EFE9 520px, #EFEEE9 100%)" }}>
      <header className="px-12 pt-12 pb-8 max-w-[1480px] mx-auto" data-screen-label="05 Header">
        <div className="flex items-baseline justify-between flex-wrap gap-y-3">
          <div>
            <div className="label-xs" style={{ color: INDIGO }}>
              Decouple · Pre-signup interview · Wireframe O5 · Expressive
            </div>
            <h1 className="serif mt-2" style={{ fontSize: 36, lineHeight: 1.1, letterSpacing: "-0.02em", fontWeight: 600 }}>
              What you know about your partner's finances — <span className="italic" style={{ fontWeight: 400, color: MAGENTA }}>screen 5 of 8</span>
            </h1>
          </div>
          <div className="flex items-center gap-3 text-[12px] mono" style={{ color: SUB }}>
            <AnnotPill color={INDIGO}>O5</AnnotPill>
            <span>preSignup.partnerFinanceAwareness</span>
            <span style={{ color: "#C9C5BD" }}>·</span>
            <span>{`{hiddenAssetsFlag}`}</span>
          </div>
        </div>
        <p className="mt-4 max-w-[920px] text-[14px]" style={{ color: SUB, lineHeight: 1.6 }}>
          One question, four options — and the most sensitive screen in the eight. The fourth option
          quietly gates a hidden-assets pathway later in the plan, so it has to live on the page
          without making the screen feel like a fishing expedition or pushing anyone toward it. Three
          calls below: how the suspicion option is presented, how (and whether) the helper text
          reassures, and the order the four answers sit in.
        </p>
      </header>

      <main className="px-12 pb-24 max-w-[1480px] mx-auto" data-screen-label="05 Resolved">

        {/* RESOLVED + RAIL */}
        <section className="grid gap-12" style={{ gridTemplateColumns: "minmax(0, 391px) 1fr" }} data-screen-label="05 Resolved live">

          <div className="flex flex-col items-center">
            <div className="mb-5 self-stretch flex items-baseline justify-between">
              <div className="label-xs" style={{ color: INK }}>RESOLVED · LIVE</div>
              <button type="button"
                      onClick={() => setAnswer(null)}
                      className="mono text-[10.5px]"
                      style={{ color: MUTE, letterSpacing: "0.06em", textDecoration: "underline", textUnderlineOffset: 3, cursor: "pointer", background: "transparent", border: "none", padding: 0 }}>
                reset
              </button>
            </div>
            <ResolvedFrame answer={answer} setAnswer={setAnswer} />
          </div>

          <div className="space-y-6">
            <div className="plate p-6">
              <div className="label-xs mb-4" style={{ color: INDIGO }}>Live state</div>
              <div className="space-y-3 text-[13px]" style={{ color: SUB, lineHeight: 1.5 }}>
                <div className="flex items-baseline gap-3">
                  <span className="mono text-[11px]" style={{ color: MUTE, width: 160 }}>partnerFinanceAwareness</span>
                  <span className="mono text-[12.5px]" style={{ color: answer ? INK : MUTE }}>
                    {answer ?? "— not answered —"}
                  </span>
                </div>
                <div className="flex items-center gap-3 pt-2 mt-2" style={{ borderTop: `1px solid ${LINE}` }}>
                  <span className="mono text-[11px]" style={{ color: MUTE, width: 160 }}>hiddenAssetsFlag</span>
                  <span className="mono inline-flex items-center gap-1.5 px-2 py-1 rounded"
                        style={{
                          background: hiddenAssetsFlag ? INK : "#FFFFFF",
                          color: hiddenAssetsFlag ? "#FFFFFF" : MUTE,
                          border: `1px solid ${hiddenAssetsFlag ? INK : LINE}`,
                          fontSize: 10, letterSpacing: "0.04em"
                        }}>
                    <span style={{
                      width: 6, height: 6, borderRadius: 999,
                      background: hiddenAssetsFlag ? "#FFFFFF" : "#D6D3CC"
                    }} />
                    {answer ? (hiddenAssetsFlag ? "true" : "false") : "—"}
                  </span>
                </div>
                <div className="flex items-baseline gap-3 pt-2" style={{ borderTop: `1px solid ${LINE}` }}>
                  <span className="mono text-[11px]" style={{ color: MUTE, width: 160 }}>derived · disclosure support</span>
                  <span className="mono text-[12px]" style={{ color: answer ? INK : MUTE }}>
                    {supportLevel}
                  </span>
                </div>
                {answer === "suspect" && (
                  <p className="text-[12px] pt-1" style={{ color: SUB, lineHeight: 1.5 }}>
                    Quietly adds a hidden-assets pathway to the plan output (screen 7) — a checklist
                    of records to gather and a forensic-accountant sidebar. No mention of this on
                    screen 5 itself. The user discovers it as a normal part of their plan.
                  </p>
                )}
                {answer === "little" && (
                  <p className="text-[12px] pt-1" style={{ color: SUB, lineHeight: 1.5 }}>
                    Plan emphasises the disclosure-support track: walkthroughs of where to find
                    statements, what Form E asks for, and a step that explicitly anticipates
                    "I don't have this" answers.
                  </p>
                )}
                {(answer === "full" || answer === "some") && (
                  <p className="text-[12px] pt-1" style={{ color: SUB, lineHeight: 1.5 }}>
                    Plan uses the standard disclosure track. We still ask for everything, but the
                    UI assumes you can answer most prompts without external help.
                  </p>
                )}
              </div>
            </div>

            <div className="plate p-6">
              <div className="label-xs mb-3" style={{ color: INDIGO }}>Try these</div>
              <div className="grid grid-cols-2 gap-2 text-[12px]">
                {[
                  { label: "I have a good idea",      k: "full"    },
                  { label: "Some but not all",        k: "some"    },
                  { label: "Very little",             k: "little"  },
                  { label: "I suspect they're hiding…", k: "suspect" }
                ].map((s) => (
                  <button key={s.k} type="button"
                          onClick={() => setAnswer(s.k)}
                          style={{
                            background: "#FFFFFF",
                            border: `1px solid ${LINE}`,
                            borderRadius: 10,
                            padding: "10px 12px",
                            textAlign: "left",
                            cursor: "pointer",
                            color: INK, fontWeight: 500
                          }}>
                    {s.label}
                  </button>
                ))}
              </div>
            </div>

            <div className="plate p-6 text-[13px]" style={{ color: SUB, lineHeight: 1.6 }}>
              <div className="label-xs mb-4" style={{ color: INDIGO }}>The three calls</div>
              <div className="space-y-4">
                <div>
                  <div className="flex items-baseline gap-3 mb-1">
                    <AnnotPill>A3</AnnotPill>
                    <span className="serif" style={{ fontSize: 14.5, fontWeight: 600, color: INK }}>Suspicion option below a hairline</span>
                  </div>
                  <p>The fourth option sits below a divider, under "If you have concerns…". It's
                  reachable in one tap, but visually outside the main spectrum — so the spectrum
                  reads as the question and the suspicion row reads as a quiet permission slip
                  for users who need it.</p>
                </div>
                <div>
                  <div className="flex items-baseline gap-3 mb-1">
                    <AnnotPill>B1</AnnotPill>
                    <span className="serif" style={{ fontSize: 14.5, fontWeight: 600, color: INK }}>"There's no wrong answer"</span>
                  </div>
                  <p>Reassures without asking the user to think about why we're asking. The
                  alternative framing ("how much support you'll need with disclosure") is more
                  transparent but introduces the word disclosure — heavier than this screen needs
                  to carry.</p>
                </div>
                <div>
                  <div className="flex items-baseline gap-3 mb-1">
                    <AnnotPill>C2</AnnotPill>
                    <span className="serif" style={{ fontSize: 14.5, fontWeight: 600, color: INK }}>Most-knowing → least, suspect set apart</span>
                  </div>
                  <p>Reads as a calm spectrum from confident to "they handled it" — a shape most
                  users will recognise themselves on. Pairing the order with A3's divider keeps
                  the suspicion row off the spectrum entirely; it's its own door.</p>
                </div>
              </div>
            </div>
          </div>
        </section>

        {/* A — SUSPICION-OPTION TREATMENT */}
        <VariantGroup
          id="A"
          screenLabel="05 A variants"
          title="How does the fourth option sit?"
          lede="The suspicion option does real work — it routes a hidden-assets pathway in the plan. But it's also the most loaded thing on the screen. Variants test how visually present it is, from full equality with the other three to a distinctly framed safety-net row at the bottom."
          resolvedKey={3}
          frames={[
            { title: "Identical weight",   node: <window.o5.A1 /> },
            { title: "Subtle de-emphasis", node: <window.o5.A2 /> },
            { title: "Below a hairline",   node: <window.o5.A3 /> }
          ]}
          blurbs={[
            "Honest — every option is equal. But on a sensitive screen it can read as the question slowly turning into an accusation by row four. No safety valve, no breathing room.",
            "Slight muted tone and a tiny caption underneath — quieter, but the user still reads it as one of four answers in the same list. The de-emphasis can also feel patronising.",
            "Separated under \"If you have concerns…\". The first three options form the spectrum; the fourth is a door, framed as the user's own concern rather than our suspicion. Calmest treatment that still keeps the option fully reachable."
          ]}
        />

        {/* B — HELPER-TEXT FRAMING */}
        <VariantGroup
          id="B"
          screenLabel="05 B variants"
          title="What does the helper text do?"
          lede="One line of helper, small. The question is whether to reassure ('no wrong answer'), be transparent about why we're asking ('helps us know how much support you'll need with disclosure'), or trust the question to stand alone. Each leans into a different theory of what's making the user nervous."
          resolvedKey={1}
          frames={[
            { title: "No wrong answer",     node: <window.o5.B1 /> },
            { title: "Disclosure framing",  node: <window.o5.B2 /> },
            { title: "No helper",           node: <window.o5.B3 /> }
          ]}
          blurbs={[
            "Names the worry directly — that there's a right answer and they're failing it. Doesn't ask the user to reason about consequences. Calmest reading; the resolved choice.",
            "More transparent: tells them the answer changes how much support we'll give. Useful in a vacuum, but introduces \"disclosure\" — a heavier word than this screen needs, and one most pre-signup users haven't met yet.",
            "Trusts the headline. Cleaner. But on a sensitive screen, silence reads as scrutiny — the user hunts for the angle and supplies their own. The space the helper would occupy isn't free."
          ]}
        />

        {/* C — ORDER OF OPTIONS */}
        <VariantGroup
          id="C"
          screenLabel="05 C variants"
          title="In what order do the answers sit?"
          lede="The four answers form a rough spectrum of self-reported knowledge — except the fourth, which is its own kind of statement. Ordering decides what the spectrum reads as, and where the eye lands first."
          resolvedKey={2}
          frames={[
            { title: "Spec verbatim",         node: <window.o5.C1 /> },
            { title: "Knowing → least",       node: <window.o5.C2 /> },
            { title: "Reversed — least first", node: <window.o5.C3 /> }
          ]}
          blurbs={[
            "Brief order. Reads top-down as a confident-to-uncertain scale that ends in suspicion — which makes the fourth option feel like the bottom of the same ladder rather than a separate question.",
            "Same first three rows, but the suspicion option is set apart below the spectrum. The eye lands on the spectrum first; the fourth row is reachable but optional in spirit. Pairs with A3.",
            "Lowers the entry bar — the first option a user reads is the most generous. Less judgemental for users who know little, but flips the implicit hierarchy and makes \"good idea\" feel like the harder claim."
          ]}
        />

        {/* CANON */}
        <section className="plate p-8 mt-12" data-screen-label="05 Canon">
          <div className="label-xs mb-4" style={{ color: INDIGO }}>Canon — inheritance from O1 / O2 / O3 / O4</div>
          <div className="grid grid-cols-3 gap-8 text-[13px]" style={{ color: SUB, lineHeight: 1.55 }}>
            <div>
              <div className="serif mb-2" style={{ fontSize: 15, fontWeight: 600, color: INK }}>Resemble</div>
              <p>Same Inter + Source Serif Pro pairing. Step rail advances to 5 / 8. Same paper-white
              cards on calmer expressive gradient as O4 — the violet stop pulled back, cream extended.
              Eyebrow stays indigo (Money) but specifies "Money · their side" so the user knows we've
              shifted from their picture to their partner's.</p>
            </div>
            <div>
              <div className="serif mb-2" style={{ fontSize: 15, fontWeight: 600, color: INK }}>Differ</div>
              <p>The hairline-divider treatment for the fourth option is new — every prior screen has
              been a flat list. We earn the divider by using it sparingly and labelling it in the
              softest serif italic on the screen. It's the only place on O5 that breaks the four-row
              rhythm.</p>
            </div>
            <div>
              <div className="serif mb-2" style={{ fontSize: 15, fontWeight: 600, color: INK }}>Constraints honoured</div>
              <p>Words "controlling", "abuse" and "victim" do not appear on the screen. No
              "I don't want to answer" affordance — the four options span the spectrum. The plan-output
              consequences of each answer are not surfaced here; gating is silent. No red, no warning
              glyphs. The screen reads as a routing question, not a flag.</p>
            </div>
          </div>
        </section>

      </main>
    </div>
  );
}

ReactDOM.createRoot(document.getElementById("root")).render(<App/>);
</script>
</body>
</html>

  <svg xmlns="http://www.w3.org/2000/svg" viewBox="0 0 400 400">
    <defs>
      <linearGradient id="thumbBg" x1="0" y1="0" x2="0" y2="1">
        <stop offset="0%" stop-color="#EEEAF4"/>
        <stop offset="100%" stop-color="#F8F5EF"/>
      </linearGradient>
    </defs>
    <rect width="400" height="400" fill="url(#thumbBg)"/>
    <g transform="translate(80 120)">
      <rect x="0"   y="0"   width="64" height="22" rx="11" fill="#1A1A1A"/>
      <rect x="72"  y="0"   width="80" height="22" rx="11" fill="#FFFFFF" stroke="#E5E3DC"/>
      <rect x="160" y="0"   width="56" height="22" rx="11" fill="#FFFFFF" stroke="#E5E3DC"/>
      <rect x="0"   y="32"  width="92" height="22" rx="11" fill="#1A1A1A"/>
      <rect x="100" y="32"  width="68" height="22" rx="11" fill="#FFFFFF" stroke="#E5E3DC"/>
      <line x1="0" y1="76" x2="240" y2="76" stroke="#D6D3CC" stroke-dasharray="3 3"/>
      <rect x="0"   y="92"  width="76" height="22" rx="11" fill="#1A1A1A"/>
      <rect x="84"  y="92"  width="100" height="22" rx="11" fill="#FFFFFF" stroke="#E5E3DC"/>
      <rect x="0"   y="146" width="240" height="14" rx="7" fill="#1A1A1A"/>
    </g>
  </svg>
</template>
<div id="root"></div>

<script type="text/babel" src="o6-frames.jsx"></script>
<script type="text/babel" data-presets="react">
const { useState } = React;
const {
  INK, SUB, MUTE, FAINT, LINE, HAIR, INDIGO, MAGENTA, VIOLET, TEAL,
  EXPRESSIVE_BG, PRIORITIES, WORRIES,
  Hero, Footer, TopBar, MobileFrame, FormBody,
  useGroupState, defaultCaption
} = window.o6;

function Arrow({ size = 13, sw = 1.8, dir = "right" }) {
  const r = { right: 0, left: 180, down: 90, up: 270 }[dir] || 0;
  return (
    <svg width={size} height={size} viewBox="0 0 24 24" fill="none" stroke="currentColor" strokeWidth={sw} strokeLinecap="round" strokeLinejoin="round" style={{ transform: `rotate(${r}deg)` }}>
      <line x1="5" y1="12" x2="19" y2="12" />
      <polyline points="12 5 19 12 12 19" />
    </svg>
  );
}

function AnnotPill({ children, color }) {
  return (
    <span className="mono inline-block px-2 py-1 rounded"
          style={{ background: color || "#1A1A1A", color: "#FFFFFF", fontSize: 10.5, letterSpacing: "0.04em" }}>
      {children}
    </span>
  );
}

/* =========================================================================
   RESOLVED FRAME — A1 (stacked cards) · B3 (calm hint) · C2 (acknowledging)
   The full live combo, with reset wired to the rail.
   ========================================================================= */
function ResolvedFrame({ pri, wor }) {
  return (
    <MobileFrame label="RESOLVED · A1 · B3 · C2">
      <TopBar />
      <Hero />
      <FormBody aTreatment="A1" bVariant="B3" cVariant="C2"
                priorities={pri} worries={wor} />
      <Footer enabled={true}
              caption={defaultCaption(pri.count, wor.count)} />
    </MobileFrame>
  );
}

/* ---------- Variant grid ---------- */
function VariantGroup({ id, title, lede, frames, resolvedKey, blurbs, screenLabel }) {
  return (
    <section className="plate p-8 mt-8" data-screen-label={screenLabel}>
      <div className="vrow">
        <div>
          <div className="label-xs" style={{ color: MAGENTA }}>Decision {id}</div>
          <h3 className="serif mt-2" style={{ fontSize: 22, lineHeight: 1.15, letterSpacing: "-0.015em", fontWeight: 600 }}>
            {title}
          </h3>
          <p className="mt-3 text-[13px]" style={{ color: SUB, lineHeight: 1.55 }}>
            {lede}
          </p>
          <div className="mt-4 mono text-[11px]" style={{ color: MUTE, letterSpacing: "0.04em", lineHeight: 1.7 }}>
            <span>resolved → </span>
            <span style={{ color: INK, fontWeight: 600 }}>{id}{resolvedKey}</span>
          </div>
        </div>

        <div className="grid gap-6" style={{ gridTemplateColumns: "repeat(3, minmax(0, 1fr))" }}>
          {frames.map((f, i) => {
            const key = `${id}${i + 1}`;
            const isResolved = key === `${id}${resolvedKey}`;
            return (
              <div key={i} className="flex flex-col">
                <div className="flex items-baseline justify-between mb-3">
                  <div className="flex items-center gap-2">
                    <AnnotPill color={isResolved ? INK : "#9F9A92"}>{key}</AnnotPill>
                    <span className="text-[12.5px]" style={{ color: INK, fontWeight: 600 }}>{f.title}</span>
                  </div>
                  {isResolved && (
                    <span className="mono text-[9.5px]" style={{ color: INK, letterSpacing: "0.06em" }}>RESOLVED</span>
                  )}
                </div>
                <div style={{
                  borderRadius: 18,
                  padding: 16,
                  background: isResolved ? "#FFFFFF" : "transparent",
                  border: isResolved ? `1px solid ${LINE}` : `1px dashed #D6D3CC`,
                  display: "flex", justifyContent: "center"
                }}>
                  <div style={{ width: 320, height: 649, position: "relative" }}>
                    <div style={{ transform: "scale(0.853)", transformOrigin: "top left", width: 375, height: 760 }}>
                      {f.node}
                    </div>
                  </div>
                </div>
                <p className="mt-3 text-[12px]" style={{ color: SUB, lineHeight: 1.5 }}>
                  {blurbs[i]}
                </p>
              </div>
            );
          })}
        </div>
      </div>
    </section>
  );
}

function App() {
  /* Live state for the resolved frame; quick-fill buttons set it. */
  const pri = useGroupState("B3");
  const wor = useGroupState("B3");

  const totalPicked = pri.count + wor.count;

  return (
    <div className="min-h-screen" style={{ background: "linear-gradient(180deg, #EEEAF4 0%, #F4EFE9 520px, #EFEEE9 100%)" }}>
      <header className="px-12 pt-12 pb-8 max-w-[1480px] mx-auto" data-screen-label="06 Header">
        <div className="flex items-baseline justify-between flex-wrap gap-y-3">
          <div>
            <div className="label-xs" style={{ color: INDIGO }}>
              Decouple · Pre-signup interview · Wireframe O6 · Expressive
            </div>
            <h1 className="serif mt-2" style={{ fontSize: 36, lineHeight: 1.1, letterSpacing: "-0.02em", fontWeight: 600 }}>
              What matters to you, what worries you — <span className="italic" style={{ fontWeight: 400, color: MAGENTA }}>screen 6 of 8</span>
            </h1>
          </div>
          <div className="flex items-center gap-3 text-[12px] mono" style={{ color: SUB }}>
            <AnnotPill color={INDIGO}>O6</AnnotPill>
            <span>preSignup.priorities · preSignup.worries</span>
            <span style={{ color: "#C9C5BD" }}>·</span>
            <span>{`max(3, 3)`}</span>
          </div>
        </div>
        <p className="mt-4 max-w-[920px] text-[14px]" style={{ color: SUB, lineHeight: 1.6 }}>
          The last input screen before the AI plan. Two multi-select chip groups — eight options
          each, capped at three — that weight the plan toward what the user actually cares about.
          The screen has to feel light at the end of an interview that has, by this point, asked
          some heavy questions. Three calls below: how the two groups separate, how the cap of
          three communicates itself, and what (if any) caption sits above an empty group.
        </p>
      </header>

      <main className="px-12 pb-24 max-w-[1480px] mx-auto" data-screen-label="06 Resolved">

        {/* RESOLVED + RAIL */}
        <section className="grid gap-12" style={{ gridTemplateColumns: "minmax(0, 391px) 1fr" }} data-screen-label="06 Resolved live">

          <div className="flex flex-col items-center">
            <div className="mb-5 self-stretch flex items-baseline justify-between">
              <div className="label-xs" style={{ color: INK }}>RESOLVED · LIVE</div>
              <button type="button"
                      onClick={() => { pri.reset(); wor.reset(); }}
                      className="mono text-[10.5px]"
                      style={{ color: MUTE, letterSpacing: "0.06em", textDecoration: "underline", textUnderlineOffset: 3, cursor: "pointer", background: "transparent", border: "none", padding: 0 }}>
                reset
              </button>
            </div>
            <ResolvedFrame pri={pri} wor={wor} />
          </div>

          <div className="space-y-6">
            <div className="plate p-6">
              <div className="label-xs mb-4" style={{ color: INDIGO }}>Live state</div>
              <div className="space-y-3 text-[13px]" style={{ color: SUB, lineHeight: 1.5 }}>
                <div className="flex items-baseline gap-3">
                  <span className="mono text-[11px]" style={{ color: MUTE, width: 160 }}>preSignup.priorities</span>
                  <span className="mono text-[11.5px]" style={{ color: pri.count ? INK : MUTE }}>
                    {pri.count ? `${pri.count} / 3` : "— none —"}
                  </span>
                </div>
                {pri.count > 0 && (
                  <ul className="text-[12px] pl-4" style={{ color: INK, lineHeight: 1.5, listStyle: "disc" }}>
                    {[...pri.set].map((x) => <li key={x}>{x}</li>)}
                  </ul>
                )}
                <div className="flex items-baseline gap-3 pt-2 mt-2" style={{ borderTop: `1px solid ${LINE}` }}>
                  <span className="mono text-[11px]" style={{ color: MUTE, width: 160 }}>preSignup.worries</span>
                  <span className="mono text-[11.5px]" style={{ color: wor.count ? INK : MUTE }}>
                    {wor.count ? `${wor.count} / 3` : "— none —"}
                  </span>
                </div>
                {wor.count > 0 && (
                  <ul className="text-[12px] pl-4" style={{ color: INK, lineHeight: 1.5, listStyle: "disc" }}>
                    {[...wor.set].map((x) => <li key={x}>{x}</li>)}
                  </ul>
                )}
                <div className="flex items-baseline gap-3 pt-2" style={{ borderTop: `1px solid ${LINE}` }}>
                  <span className="mono text-[11px]" style={{ color: MUTE, width: 160 }}>plan weighting · O7</span>
                  <span className="mono text-[12px]" style={{ color: totalPicked ? INK : MUTE }}>
                    {totalPicked === 0 ? "neutral · default" :
                     totalPicked <= 2 ? "light tilt"   :
                     totalPicked <= 4 ? "balanced"     :
                                        "strong tilt"}
                  </span>
                </div>
                <p className="text-[12px] pt-1" style={{ color: SUB, lineHeight: 1.5 }}>
                  The plan ranks sections, opens warmer or cooler copy, and chooses which calculator
                  to lead with. No answer is fine — the plan defaults to a balanced template.
                </p>
              </div>
            </div>

            <div className="plate p-6">
              <div className="label-xs mb-3" style={{ color: INDIGO }}>Try a scenario</div>
              <div className="grid grid-cols-1 gap-2 text-[12px]">
                {[
                  { label: "Home + children + clean break", pri: [PRIORITIES[1], PRIORITIES[3], PRIORITIES[4]], wor: [WORRIES[3]] },
                  { label: "Pension-anxious",                pri: [PRIORITIES[2]],                              wor: [WORRIES[2], WORRIES[0]] },
                  { label: "Just wants it done",              pri: [PRIORITIES[5], PRIORITIES[6]],               wor: [WORRIES[5], WORRIES[6]] },
                  { label: "Hidden-assets concern",           pri: [PRIORITIES[0]],                              wor: [WORRIES[1], WORRIES[7]] }
                ].map((s, i) => (
                  <button key={i} type="button"
                          onClick={() => {
                            pri.reset(); wor.reset();
                            setTimeout(() => {
                              s.pri.forEach((x) => pri.toggle(x));
                              s.wor.forEach((x) => wor.toggle(x));
                            }, 0);
                          }}
                          style={{
                            background: "#FFFFFF",
                            border: `1px solid ${LINE}`,
                            borderRadius: 10,
                            padding: "9px 11px",
                            textAlign: "left",
                            cursor: "pointer",
                            color: INK, fontWeight: 500
                          }}>
                    {s.label}
                  </button>
                ))}
              </div>
            </div>

            <div className="plate p-6 text-[13px]" style={{ color: SUB, lineHeight: 1.6 }}>
              <div className="label-xs mb-4" style={{ color: INDIGO }}>The three calls</div>
              <div className="space-y-4">
                <div>
                  <div className="flex items-baseline gap-3 mb-1">
                    <AnnotPill>A1</AnnotPill>
                    <span className="serif" style={{ fontSize: 14.5, fontWeight: 600, color: INK }}>Two stacked cards</span>
                  </div>
                  <p>The two questions are different jobs — what you want, what you fear — and a
                  shared card flattens the distinction. Stacked cards let each headline carry its
                  own weight; the fold between them gives the user permission to pause before the
                  worry list. Tabs (A3) pretend the questions are sequential; they're not.</p>
                </div>
                <div>
                  <div className="flex items-baseline gap-3 mb-1">
                    <AnnotPill>B3</AnnotPill>
                    <span className="serif" style={{ fontSize: 14.5, fontWeight: 600, color: INK }}>Calm hint at the cap</span>
                  </div>
                  <p>Disabling chips at three (B1) is correct but cold — the screen suddenly stops
                  responding. Rolling out the oldest (B2) is too clever for an answer the user
                  meant to keep. A line beneath the group is the lightest possible explanation
                  and respects the user's intent.</p>
                </div>
                <div>
                  <div className="flex items-baseline gap-3 mb-1">
                    <AnnotPill>C2</AnnotPill>
                    <span className="serif" style={{ fontSize: 14.5, fontWeight: 600, color: INK }}>Acknowledging caption</span>
                  </div>
                  <p>"Pick up to 3" (C1) is information. The two-line C2 caption is permission —
                  it gives the user a way to choose without committing to a hierarchy of feeling
                  that may not exist yet. The "you can change them later" half is load-bearing.</p>
                </div>
              </div>
            </div>
          </div>
        </section>

        {/* A — GROUP SEPARATION */}
        <VariantGroup
          id="A"
          screenLabel="06 A variants"
          title="How are the two groups separated?"
          lede="Both groups are pick-up-to-three, but they ask different things — what you want and what you fear. Variants test how loud that distinction is, and whether to make the two questions feel sequential or parallel."
          resolvedKey={1}
          frames={[
            { title: "Stacked cards",      node: <window.o6.A1 /> },
            { title: "Hairline switch",    node: <window.o6.A2 /> },
            { title: "Tabbed · gated",     node: <window.o6.A3 /> }
          ]}
          blurbs={[
            "Two paper-white cards, each with its own headline and chip group. Visual fold between them; the user is told nothing about order. Easiest to scan, lightest reading. Resolved.",
            "One card, hairline divider, two headlines. Compact and orderly. The single container subtly tells the user these are halves of the same question, which they aren't — the two answers do different work in the plan.",
            "Tabs, with the second locked until at least one chip in group 1 is selected. Forces sequencing and adds a small hit of ceremony. Useful if we needed to make the two answers feel like a single act, but on a closing screen it reads as gatekeeping."
          ]}
        />

        {/* B — CAP-FEEDBACK TREATMENT */}
        <VariantGroup
          id="B"
          screenLabel="06 B variants"
          title="What happens at three?"
          lede="The cap is three. Three is generous on a question of this kind, but a hard cap still asks the user to choose between things they wouldn't normally rank. Variants test how the cap announces itself, and whether it punishes a fourth tap or lets it through."
          resolvedKey={3}
          frames={[
            { title: "Disabled at cap",      node: <window.o6.B1 /> },
            { title: "Oldest rolls out",     node: <window.o6.B2 /> },
            { title: "Calm hint below",      node: <window.o6.B3 /> }
          ]}
          blurbs={[
            "Unselected chips fade and refuse to respond once three are picked. Honest, but feels like the screen has stopped working. The user is left to figure out why on their own — and on a sensitive group like the worries, that small dead end is a bad note to end the interview on.",
            "All chips stay live; tapping a fourth quietly drops the oldest selection. Clever, and saves a tap, but it can also remove an answer the user genuinely meant. We're not confident it's discoverable without the small caption hint, and the caption then has to apologise for the behaviour.",
            "Chips stay live, a calm one-liner appears beneath the group: \"you can pick up to 3 — drop one to add another.\" The fourth tap simply doesn't take effect; the user reads the line, drops one, moves on. Lightest of the three, no surprises. Resolved."
          ]}
        />

        {/* C — EMPTY-STATE GUIDANCE */}
        <VariantGroup
          id="C"
          screenLabel="06 C variants"
          title="What do we say above an empty group?"
          lede="The chips do most of the talking. The question is whether to put a caption above each group — and if so, whether to be terse, acknowledging, or to skip the caption and let an inline counter carry the cap."
          resolvedKey={2}
          frames={[
            { title: "Terse — \"Pick up to 3\"",    node: <window.o6.C1 /> },
            { title: "Acknowledging two-liner",     node: <window.o6.C2 /> },
            { title: "Inline counter, no caption",  node: <window.o6.C3 /> }
          ]}
          blurbs={[
            "One line. Says what it has to and nothing more. Reads as a form, which the rest of the interview has carefully avoided being. On the closing screen we've earned a softer tone than this gives us.",
            "Two lines: \"these can be hard to pick — go with what feels true today, you can change them later.\" Names the difficulty without dwelling on it, and the editable promise is what makes the cap feel survivable. Resolved.",
            "No caption. \"(0 of 3)\" sits inline with the headline and updates as chips are picked. Cleanest visually; the headline carries the whole thing. But on these particular questions, silence reads as judgement — the user is alone with the wording."
          ]}
        />

        {/* CANON */}
        <section className="plate p-8 mt-12" data-screen-label="06 Canon">
          <div className="label-xs mb-4" style={{ color: INDIGO }}>Canon — inheritance from O1 / O5</div>
          <div className="grid grid-cols-3 gap-8 text-[13px]" style={{ color: SUB, lineHeight: 1.55 }}>
            <div>
              <div className="serif mb-2" style={{ fontSize: 15, fontWeight: 600, color: INK }}>Resemble</div>
              <p>Same Inter + Source Serif Pro pairing, same calmer expressive gradient as O5 — the
              violet stop pulled back, cream extended further down. Step rail at 6 / 8. The eyebrow
              swaps from O5's indigo (Money) to a quiet magenta — this screen isn't a money question,
              it's a values question. Continue button reads "Build my plan" because the next screen
              is the plan.</p>
            </div>
            <div>
              <div className="serif mb-2" style={{ fontSize: 15, fontWeight: 600, color: INK }}>Differ</div>
              <p>Chips, not radio rows — multi-select, and the answers are short. Two questions on
              one screen is new for the interview; the stacked-card layout is the only place this
              has been tried. Inline counter and below-cap hint are unique to this screen and
              shouldn't escape it without justification.</p>
            </div>
            <div>
              <div className="serif mb-2" style={{ fontSize: 15, fontWeight: 600, color: INK }}>Constraints honoured</div>
              <p>No "Other" or free-text field — the picks are calibrated. No minimum-1 enforcement —
              a user who genuinely has no priority yet can still continue, and the plan adapts.
              Spec-65 chip order preserved (no alphabetisation). Cap is three on each side; nothing
              about the screen pushes a user to fill it.</p>
            </div>
          </div>
        </section>

      </main>
    </div>
  );
}

ReactDOM.createRoot(document.getElementById("root")).render(<App/>);
</script>
</body>
</html>

  /* text size shortcuts (only the ones used) */

  /* ---------- project specifics ---------- */
  .o7-no-scrollbar::-webkit-scrollbar { height: 6px; }

  @media (prefers-reduced-motion: reduce) {
    * { animation: none !important; transition: none !important; }
